pages.title: What it does
text: Right-click to gain 1 allocatable point without gaining a level and without touching your experience.
One point per scroll by default (items.skill_scroll.points = 1, configurable).

pages.title: Crafting
text: Gold ingot + lapis lazuli + paper, shaped.

pages.title: When to use it
text: When you want points ahead of schedule, or want to gift some to a friend. Points are persisted, so a disconnect cannot eat them.
